name: How much does a room addition typically cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does a room addition typically cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a room addition in Los Angeles varies significantly based on factors like size, complexity, materials chosen, and interior finishes. Basic additions might start from $200-$300 per square foot, but custom or luxury additions can easily exceed $500 per square foot. This includes design, permitting, labor, and materials. It's essential to get detailed estimates from several contractors, as site-specific challenges or unique architectural requirements can also impact the final price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Room addition costs in Los Angeles vary widely, typically ranging from $200 to over $500 per square foot, depending on size, complexity, and materials.
